chunks: This (city) lies on a road that still survives.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a city is described as being on a 'road that still survives'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ad-Dukhan, this verse describes the path of the disbelievers of Mecca as 'firm' or 'established' (muqim), indicating their steadfastness in their error and the certainty of their impending punishment. Shia exegetes often interpret this 'path' not merely as a physical location but as a spiritual trajectory of stubbornness that leads to the Fire, contrasting with the path of the righteous.
